environment.description: Lambda function deployed with a Function URL where AuthType is set to AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy specifies a Condition block requiring 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' equals 'AWS_IAM' and the Principal is restricted to 'arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/InternalTaskSchedulerRole'. Note: the function URL itself remains publicly routable (HTTPS endpoint exists and responds), but the Lambda service's built-in invoke authorization layer returns a 403 Forbidden with message '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request that does not carry a valid SigV4 signature from the authorized IAM principal. The execution role has the same broad permissions. There is no WAF, no VPC, no network-level restriction — the control is purely the IAM auth requirement on the function URL invoke path. CloudTrail logging is enabled but does not block requests.
